paths.why: The three backup rules proposed by this classification.

1 KB, and the only versioned identity the 472 MB R3 backup would have. R4 and R5 each track their backup's MANIFEST.json and two .sha256 sidecars; R3 tracks nothing and has no sidecars at all, so ignoring the directory wholesale would destroy the digest in exactly the event it exists to detect. This manifest already carries both payload sha256 values inline, so tracking it alone completes the arrangement without needing sidecars.
